row:
Cuan Wildlife Rescue is Shropshire's only 24/7 centre looking after sick and injured animals. We treat and release all wildlife that come into our hospital and run entirely on donations. 

See what it’s like behind the scenes at one of the UK’s busiest wildlife hospitals. 

OUR WEBSITE 
www.cuanwildlife.org.uk

Registered Charity No: 1096812
